title: FUS and Tactile Neuromodulation in NHP VPL - Electrophysiology
description: Intracranial electrophysiology recordings from the ventral posterolateral (VPL) thalamus of macaques, collected with a 32-channel linear probe during transcranial focused ultrasound (FUS) neuromodulation and tactile stimulation. FUS was targeted either to VPL thalamus or to insular cortex while recording remained in VPL. The dataset includes spiking and local field potential recordings supporting a study of FUS effects on primate thalamic activity.
methods_description: Recordings used a NeuroNexus V1x32-Edge single-shank probe (32 sites, 100 µm pitch) in right-hemisphere VPL, acquired with a Blackrock Cerebus/CerePlex system at 30 kHz for spikes and 1 kHz for LFP. FUS was applied to VPL or insular cortex, and tactile stimulation was delivered to the contralateral hand. Raw Blackrock files were read with NPMK in MATLAB and exported to NWB using MatNWB.
